title: Social Media Management vs Paid Social Ads: What Do You Need?
h1: Social media management vs paid social ads: what do you need?
description: The difference between organic social media management and paid social advertising: goals, costs, timelines, what each freelancer does and how to combine them.
intro: Social media work comes in two very different forms. Social media management builds your presence over time with regular posts, community replies and a consistent brand. Paid social advertising buys reach and results quickly by targeting specific audiences with ads. Many businesses mix them up and hire the wrong specialist, then wonder why followers do not turn into sales or why ads stop working when the budget ends. This article explains both and how they work together.

faq.a: Paid ads, usually within days. Organic growth takes months of consistent posting.

faq.q: Do I need many followers before running ads?
faq.a: No. Ads can reach new people regardless of follower count, though a credible profile helps.

faq.q: Is the ad budget included in the freelancer's fee?
faq.a: No. Ad spend is paid to the platform; the freelancer charges for setup and management.
Some can, but the skills differ. Check examples of each.

faq.q: Should I buy followers to look established?
faq.a: No. Fake followers hurt engagement and can break platform rules.
